svg.title: ClearSky architecture: CloudFront serves the dashboard from S3 and routes /api to a Lambda API that verifies Cognito sign-in. The API starts scans, chat and diagram jobs. A daily EventBridge schedule runs the scanner, which assumes a read-only role in each member account, stores findings in DynamoDB and sends an SNS digest by email. GitHub Actions deploys through OIDC roles.
svg.text: AWS Cloud · ClearSky account (us-east-1, scans every region)
